title: Marketing Campaigns
notes: Rebuilt on ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage archetypes, now wired to the correct /marketing/campaigns/* backend (previously the list page silently called the unrelated legacy /campaigns endpoints). Added marketingApi.campaigns.* client module (list/get/create/update/delete/send/cancel/analytics/recipients — update is defined but unused, no edit page was in scope). Create page added with channel/segment/schedule fields; detail page added with analytics stats, campaign details, and a recipients table, plus send/cancel/delete actions. Sidebar 'Campaigns' link and marketing dashboard links repointed from /campaigns to /marketing/campaigns. No relation field warrants PhoneInput/AddressAutocomplete/CurrencyInput here, and no SendMessageDialog integration — sending IS the campaign-level action (POST .../send), there's no distinct 1:1 outbound message step to wrap. Campaign scheduler cron table mismatch (#11) is a backend issue, out of scope.
showcaseScript: Create a multi-channel campaign with a flyer attached
Open the analytics view and show delivery and engagement
